The '''C1-4W''',<ref name="Onslaught" /> also known as the '''C1-4W claw machine gonk droid''', was a model of bipedal [[Power droid/Legends|power droid]]<ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|username=nonentity|url=artwork/VgwoJR|name=[[Bradley W. Lewis|Bradley Lewis]]|text=SWTOR &#124; C1-4W Claw Machine Gonk Droid|quote=I designed and modeled/textured this C1-4W claw machine gonk droid as a Nar Shadaa Nightlife event reward. I even got the animators to do a cloth sim on the claw so it would dangle around while it walked.}}</ref> available during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A functional miniature version of this droid known as a "Replica C1-4W" also existed.<ref name="Onslaught" />

These droids were primarily plated in a [[Color/Legends|silver]] and dark gray color. The upper portion of their bodies were hollow, surrounded by transparent plating. Their interior could be filled with trinkets, currency, gemstones, and other prizes, all of which could be accessed via a claw arm suspended from the upper-inside portion of the droid and a series of controls displayed on the exterior.<ref name="Onslaught" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A "Replica C1-4W minipet" was released as a part of the annual [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] Nightlife event in 2021, available as a prize from the [[Emperor's Grace Slot Machine]]s, all within the [[2019]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' expansion for [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Onslaught" />

The C1-4W droid was designed by concept artist [[Bradley W. Lewis]], who first revealed on his ArtStation account the droid's full name, the fact that it's name is a reference to the word "claw," and how he convinced the animators to let the claw dangle and swing when the droid walked.<ref name="ArtStation" />
